description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a .NET Tech Lead / Senior .NET Developer based in India.

We are looking for an experienced .NET Tech Lead / Senior .NET Developer to drive the development, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise applications. In this fully remote role, you will combine hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, working across frontend, backend, and database technologies. You will play a key role in understanding existing application architecture, improving business workflows, and delivering reliable technical solutions. Working closely with business stakeholders, QA specialists, and engineering teams, you will help translate requirements into effective application enhancements. You will also contribute to code quality, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making while supporting and mentoring other developers. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on application performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

lists.content:
As a .NET Tech Lead / Senior .NET Developer, you will oversee and contribute to the evolution of existing enterprise applications while ensuring technical quality and operational reliability. You will be responsible for delivering enhancements, resolving complex issues, and providing technical guidance throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Lead and contribute to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of existing applications.

  • Develop and maintain frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and ASP.NET MVC views.

  • Implement backend business logic using C#, ASP.NET MVC, and Web API/RESTful services.

  • Design, develop, optimize, and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and database operations.

  • Analyze and enhance existing business validation rules, data-processing workflows, and application integrations.

  • Support inbound and outbound file processing, scheduled jobs, and background-processing operations.

  • Investigate and resolve application defects, production incidents, and data discrepancies.

  • Conduct code reviews, recommend technical solutions, enforce coding standards, and provide guidance to development team members.

  • Participate in requirements analysis, technical design, effort estimation, testing, deployments, and production support.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, QA specialists, and technical teams to deliver application improvements and resolve technical challenges.

  • Promote maintainable, scalable, and reliable development practices across the application lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on .NET development experience, excellent SQL Server expertise, and the ability to work effectively with existing enterprise applications. A combination of technical problem-solving, application troubleshooting, and leadership skills is essential.

  • Strong proficiency in C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, and the .NET Framework.

  • Solid frontend development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, and database troubleshooting.

  • Experience developing and integrating Web APIs and RESTful services.

  • Familiarity with Entity Framework or similar Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) technologies.

  • Good understanding of MVC and layered application architectures, dependency injection, and debugging techniques.

  • Experience using Git or other source-control tools.

  • Strong analytical, communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand existing applications, implement technical solutions, review code, and guide other developers.

  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and resolving production issues.

    • Additional experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Hangfire or similar background-job scheduling frameworks.

  • SFTP, SSH.NET, PGP, and file-processing integrations.

  • SQLBulkCopy and large-volume data-processing operations.

  • Single Sign-On (SSO), role-based authorization, application logging, and error-handling mechanisms.

  • NUnit, xUnit, or similar unit-testing frameworks.

  • Modern .NET technologies, including .NET 5–10, .NET Core, Web API, and React or Angular.

  • Development experience using AI-powered tools.

  • Python development experience.

  • Relevant .NET certifications.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement.

  • Full-time employment opportunity.

  • Opportunity to take ownership of enterprise application development and enhancement.

  • Hands-on involvement across frontend, backend, database, and integration technologies.

  • Opportunity to provide technical leadership and mentor development team members.

  • Exposure to modern development tools and technologies, including AI-assisted software development.
